maria-support: Hey support team — customer (AcmeHealth) opened a ticket: their A/B rollout dashboard for exp-2026-04-search-boost shows Variant A has ~75% assignments in the UI, but their assignment logs/events show Variant B at ~75%. They say it's urgent (affects clinical search). Screenshot: https://rwd-prod.s3/xxxx/exp-2026-04-ui.png

devon-product: thanks — can you paste the org/project/rollout id and a quick repro (API call or snippet)? also is this hosted or dedicated?

maria-support: Org: acmehealth, project: acme-patient-search, rollout_id: exp-2026-04-search-boost. Dedicated customer. Repro steps from customer: 1) query assignments API: `GET /v1/assignments?exp_id=exp-2026-04-search-boost&window=48h` -> payload includes assignment counts (payload attached). 2) Dashboard Insights > AB Overview shows swapped percentages. They attached a small CSV from their event stream showing counts per cohort.

liam-eng-ml: I'm taking this. Quick hypothesis: we shipped the cohort-key normalization migration yesterday (cohort_key_v2) and there was a rename/alias step in the ETL. Possible join mismatch between label column and count column. Pulling ingest logs now.

nora-data: I see two schemas in the assignments table for that rollout: `cohort_key_old` (legacy) and `cohort_key` (normalized). UI join is using `cohort_key_old` for labels but the materialized counts were computed grouping by `cohort_key`. If the normalization function permuted values for some legacy keys, that would explain the swapped labels versus counts. Example SQL: 
```
SELECT
  COALESCE(cohort_key_old, cohort_key) AS cohort_label,
  COUNT(*) AS assignment_count
FROM assignments
WHERE rollout_id='exp-2026-04-search-boost' AND ts >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY 1;
```

maria-support: Customer-facing update: "We see inconsistent cohort mapping in our internal dashboard; engineering is investigating. Will update within 2 hours"

liam-eng-ml: Confirmed in logs: the normalizer map for key `zip-variant` became `zip-variant-01` for new rows due to a mapping table change. Old rows still have `zip-variant`. UI code does label = cohort_key_old but counts join uses normalized key. Quick mitigation: change the dashboard join to prefer `cohort_key_old` if present (fall back to normalized) so counts and labels align until we backfill. I'll prepare a canary patch.

devon-product: Good. Also plan a backfill to reconcile normalized keys -> legacy mapping so historic snapshots match. Add a dashboard "stale" banner until backfill completes and mark affected rollout in insights.

ops-bot: Deploy started by liam-eng-ml at 1955554700 (canary). :eyes:

nora-data: Backfill plan: reprocess assignments for the rollout for the last 72 hours, materialize unified_cohort_key using the `legacy_map` table, then rebuild per-rollout aggregates. Job id: bf-1955-01, ETA ~20 minutes on dedicated infra. SQL snippet to run in backfill: 
```
-- pseudo
INSERT INTO assignments_recomputed (rollout_id, ts, unified_cohort_key)
SELECT rollout_id, ts, COALESCE(cohort_key_old, legacy_map[cohort_key])
FROM assignments
WHERE rollout_id='exp-2026-04-search-boost' AND ts >= now() - interval '72 hours';
```

liam-eng-ml: Canary patch deployed to 1 instance (20% traffic). Observed: dashboard label/counts align for the canary slice. Pushing to 25% now.

maria-support: Sent customer update: "We identified cohort-key aliasing in our pipeline causing label/count mismatches. We're patching the dashboard and running a backfill; ETA ~2 hours. We'll follow up when complete." They replied: "Thanks — please flag if we should pause any experiments."

devon-product: Create ticket and postmortem placeholder: TICKET-7891. Owners: liam-eng-ml (patch), nora-data (backfill), maria-support (customer comms). Add timeline and rollback criteria.

maria-support: Thanks team — keeping customer updated. Please ping here when backfill completes so I can close the loop. :pray:

liam-eng-ml: Backfill job bf-1955-01 started at 1955555120, progress 0%. Will post progress updates.

ops-bot: Backfill job bf-1955-01 progress: 50% at 1955555400.

nora-data: Backfill complete at 1955555700. Aggregates rebuilt, dashboard snapshots regenerated. Running smoke checks now.

liam-eng-ml: Smoke checks good. Canary -> 100% rollout of patch complete at 1955555760. Dashboard shows consistent counts/labels across historic window.

maria-support: Customer notified: issue resolved, explanation and postmortem to follow. They thanked us and asked for the PM to share RCA.

devon-product: I'll own the RCA write-up. Initial cause: cohort key normalization + incomplete alias backfill + UI join order. Preventative actions: add migration checklist item (backfill + UI guard), add unit tests for cohort join, add a dashboard-level data-consistency alert for rollout label-count divergence.

maria-support: Great, closing customer ticket after RCA. :+1:

liam-eng-ml: adding logs to TICKET-7891 and including patch diff.

nora-data: adding backfill metrics and runtime to the ticket.

maria-support: thanks everyone.
